commands.command:
date -u
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
cat /proc/uptime
ls -ld /usr/apps /opt/usr/apps
for d in /usr/apps/* /opt/usr/apps/*; do
 case "$d" in
 *[Pp]ower*|*[Nn]otif*|*[Rr]emind*|*[Oo]ptim*|*[Ss]ystem*|*[Ss]creen*|*[Oo][Ll][Ee][Dd]*|*[Dd]isplay*)
  if test -d "$d/bin"; then
   echo "CANDIDATE $d/bin"
   ls "$d/bin"
  fi
 ;;
 esac
done
date -u
